takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Sit High and Stand Up Again
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly approaches a high seated position, settling with hands by the hips or on the thighs before rising. The last rise ends in an upright step.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Alternate High Sitting and Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves into several high seated poses, bracing the hands near the hips or placing them on the thighs between rises. They finish with a brief turn and a bent-knee step.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Sit High from Several Angles
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright steps with several high seated poses, including side-facing sits with the feet drawn back. The take ends in another bent-knee seated position.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on stepstool, chin in hand
takes.title: Sit Low and Rest the Chin on a Hand
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers into a squat-height seated pose, shifts orientation, and brings one hand to the chin. They repeat the low sit and finish by stepping away.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on stepstool, hands against chin, fidget, stand up
takes.title: Sit Low, Fidget, and Sit Again
takes.actionDescription: The performer sits low with hands near the chin, changes hand and torso positions, and rises between repetitions. The take ends seated with the hands gathered in front.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on stepstool, hands against chin, elbow out, stand up
takes.title: Sit Low with an Elbow Set Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates between standing and low sits, changing from an elbow-out posture to a raised hand and a side-facing sit. They finish standing in profile.

takes.title: Mime Opening a Bottle and Drinking
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings the hands together in front of the chest, then repeatedly raises one hand toward the mouth while standing. The CMU source identifies the hand motions as opening a bottle and drinking.

takes.sourceDescription: unscrew bottlecap, drink soda, screw on bottlecap
takes.title: Mime Opening, Drinking, and Recapping a Bottle
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands together, raises one hand to the mouth in several intervals, and finishes with both hands together near the chest. The CMU source identifies a bottle cap.

takes.title: Mime Taking Several Sips While Standing
takes.actionDescription: From a wide stance, the performer repeatedly lifts one hand to the mouth and tips the head back. They lower the arm and return upright at the end.
